svg.text: Weight loading: from config.json to the runtime model
Every rank runs these steps itself, from the same HF folder · commit 9bd9cf2
example in panel 3: 8 logical experts (not from the repo), EP size 3, DEEPINFER_OVERRIDE_NUM_EXTRA_EXPERTS=0
How does config.json become the model config?
The parser checks the format first. Later steps add runtime and parallel fields to the same AttrDict.
In which order does DeepseekForCausalLM.load_model work?
The checks run before any weight is read. A missing parameter stops the load with RuntimeError.
check the files, plan the coverage
build every parameter on the meta device
tie MTP embedding and head to the backbone
cuda; Engram tables on cpu unless forced to the device
load: missing check, shape check, then copy
3 channels: ordinary, routed experts, Engram tables
build the runtime model from the containers
Which experts does each EP rank read?
extra = 0 + (-(8 + 0) % 3) = 1, so 9 physical slots, 3 per rank. The extra slot (extra index 0) copies expert 0 % 8 = 0.
slot 8 reads expert 0 from the HF files
Engram rows follow the Engram group, not the EP group (engram_parameters.py:18-31). The expert count 8 is an example.
Not shown: skip_load (load_format "dummy"), which makes dummy weights and reads no file (deepseek.py:488-494).
